name: Worktree Kit Sync
description: Copies your gitignored local files (CLAUDE.md, .claude, .mcp.json, .env, anything you list) into every new worktree, in every repo, before the agent starts.

settings.title: Files and folders to copy
settings.description: One per line, relative to the repo root; # starts a comment. Only files git sees as untracked or ignored are copied, and a file that already exists in the worktree is never overwritten. Clear the box to turn copying off.

settings.title: Size limit (MB)
settings.description: If the files to copy add up to more than this, nothing is copied and a line is written to the plugin log.
